description: An agent that maps a research question: it retrieves papers, separates those that answer the question from surrounding topics, links related papers and proposes testable research gaps, with every claim tied to a verbatim quote and independently checked.
track: Track 02: The Agent That Can Explain Why

team.name: Ting Bai
team.role: Co-developer across the whole project; main areas: setup and hackathon requirements, Nightshift/Nemotron integration, Planner, Retriever, Zetaris paper store, Meterless World Model, reliability fixes and the English interface

team.name: Xin Tian
team.role: Co-developer across the whole project; main areas: question-aware clustering and cluster roles, Connection and Gap finders, review agent, interactive map, Fast/Pro modes, evaluation, parallel model calls and search budgets

sponsor_technologies.meterless_nightshift: Primary AI provider for every LLM call (OpenAI-compatible client)
sponsor_technologies.meterless_engine: World Model (Python port of the Meterless spec, all 8 conformance checks pass): shared findings graph returned as paper_map and served by GET /world/{run_id}
sponsor_technologies.zetaris: Data layer running locally in Docker: papers written to our Postgres store and read back by every later agent through Zetaris SQL (litagent_db.papers)
sponsor_technologies.nvidia: Nemotron 3 Ultra via Nightshift's NVIDIA provider for every agent that builds the map; the checks of their work run on DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 through Nightshift (a second model family)
sponsor_technologies.cursor: Development environment; project rules in .cursor/rules/project.mdc give every Cursor agent request the architecture and conventions
